To Whomsoever It May Concern,
This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the
said agency has executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their
performance has been found satisfactory.
1. PROJECT DETAILS
Project Name

Bridges Flyovers

2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT
Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was cooperative, with weekly progress
reporting maintained without prompting, and . On that basis the agency has been placed on
our approved-agency list for this class of work.
Criterion

Excellent

Good

Good

3. RECOMMENDATION
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and
cost, and their conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for
similar works.
